Marketplace product registration

API for synchronizing directly to marketplaces using product information registered in Shoplinker.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/MallProductReg.html?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required product_id string Shoplinker product code Product code issued by Shoplinker
ex) prod0001213
3. Required group_id string Shoplinker product group information code The group_id value returned by the Shoplinker product group information query API
ex) 00012154
4. Required mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code * Enter this code accurately. If the marketplace is not listed, add it in the marketplace setup. ex )APISHOP_0001
5. Required user_id string Marketplace seller account Account information used to sell on the marketplace
ex) Auction:a2356, Gmarket : g1234, etc.
6. Required category_gubun string Category selection Optional- Use the mapped category : 001
- Use the product group category : 002		 Select a category for marketplace synchronization
7. currently_sale_price string Marketplace sale price Set this field to override the marketplace selling price of PROD00001.
8. currently_supply_price string Marketplace supply price Set this field to override the marketplace supply price of PROD00001.
9. currently_market_price string Marketplace list price Set this field to override the marketplace market price of PROD00001.
10. currently_model string Model name Set this field to override the model name of PROD00001.
11. currently_brand string Brand Set this field to override the brand of PROD00001.
12. currently_product_name string Product name Set this field to override the product name of PROD00001.
13. lclass_id string Shoplinker level 1 product category code Refer to the Excel data
14. item_seq string Item detail code Refer to the Excel data
15. item_info string Item detailed description Refer to the Excel data
16. weight string Weight Digits only; decimal points are not allowed
ex)11
17. mall_cate_code string Marketplace category code Supported only for ESM, Interpark, 11st, Coupang, and Smart Store Applies only to companies separately provided with marketplace categories by Shoplinker
ex) Auction leaf category code : 10510123

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ProductMallReg>
		<Productinfo>
			<customer_id>a000124</customer_id>
			<product_id>prod001023</product_id>
			<group_id>00612360</group_id>
			<user_id>apidf</user_id>
			<mall_id>APISHOP_0010</mall_id>
			<currently_sale_price>27000</currently_sale_price>
			<currently_supply_price>27000</currently_supply_price>
			<currently_market_price>27000</currently_market_price>
			<goodsinfo>
				<lclass_id>i01</lclass_id>
				<item>
					<item_seq>0101</item_seq>
					<item_info><![CDATA[제품소재]]></item_info>
				</item>
				<item>
					<item_seq>0102</item_seq>
					<item_info><![CDATA[색상]]></item_info>
				</item>
				<item>
					<item_seq>내용</item_seq>
					<item_info><![CDATA[내용]]></item_info>
				</item>
				.
				.
				.
				<item>
					반복
				</item>
			</goodsinfo>
		</Productinfo>
	</ProductMallReg>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Optional
  • - Success : true
  • - Failure : false
2. product_id string Marketplace product code<^**^>Shoplinker product code On success, e.g. B000123005<^**^>prod0001213
On failure, e.g. Failure<^**^>prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P1524578<^**^>prod13456789</product_id>
		<message>등록성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
